$comment: MET values from the 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities (pacompendium2024).
Formula: kcal = MET x body mass in kg x hours.
RULES: every value must carry its Compendium activity code. If no code exists for an
activity, set 'approximated_from' and add a matching assumption entry to
project_memory/assumptions.md. Never invent a MET value.
This file is the reference the exercise catalogue is authored against; the values that
ship are the met_value fields in app/src/main/assets/exercises_seed.json.

activities.label: Elliptical trainer, light effort
activities.$note: The Compendium's lowest elliptical entry is moderate effort at 5.0 (02048); it has no light-effort elliptical code. Scaled down to the stationary-cycling light-effort value (4.0, code 01214) because the machines are mechanically comparable at an easy pace. Needed so the elliptical has a recovery-anchored exercise for warm-ups and spin-downs. See assumptions.md A-0009.

activities.label: Bicycling, stationary, 25-30 watts, very light to light effort
activities.$note: Also used as the ACTIVE_RECOVERY MET in EstimateEnergyExpenditure.

activities.label: Pilates, traditional, mat
activities.$note: Was carried on the bodyweight modality until D-0042 split the mat repertoire out. The only bodyweight movement left at this value was cat cow, which is a mobilising stretch rather than Pilates, so it moved to code 02101 and this row moved with the repertoire it describes.

activities.label: Stretching, mild (used for mat Pilates spinal mobility)
activities.$note: Supine spine twist and spine stretch forward are mobilising movements rather than a general Pilates class, so the stretching code is the closer fit. Not an approximation: 02101 documents exactly this kind of work.

activities.label: Calisthenics, moderate effort (used for the classical mat repertoire)
activities.$note: The Compendium's Pilates codes stop at 2.8 (02105), which understates sustained classical work — roll up, criss cross, side kick series, teaser, neck pull. Matched to moderate calisthenics rather than invented, the same substitution the reformer 3.8 row makes. See assumptions.md A-0012.

activities.label: Pilates, general (used for reformer)
activities.$note: The 2024 Compendium has no reformer entry. See assumptions.md A-0004. Likely an underestimate; underestimating expenditure is the safe direction.

activities.label: Stretching, mild (used for reformer mobility work)
activities.$note: Reformer mobility work — mermaid, supine arm springs — is closer to mild stretching than to a general Pilates class, so the stretching code is the better fit. Same reformer caveat as A-0004.

activities.label: Calisthenics, moderate effort (used for loaded reformer work)
activities.$note: Long stretch, knee stretches and teaser on the reformer are sustained loaded work, above a general Pilates class. Matched to moderate calisthenics rather than invented. Same reformer caveat as A-0004.

activities.label: Calisthenics, light effort (curl ups, crunches, plank)
Calisthenics, moderate effort (pushups, sit ups, lunges)
High intensity interval exercise, moderate effort
Walking / marching in place, slow
activities.$note: Used for the march-in-place warm-up; the closest documented very-light continuous entry.

activities.label: Sitting quietly
activities.$note: The RESTING_MET in EstimateEnergyExpenditure. Rest segments are charged at this rather than zero (D-0006).
